name: GetContact

search.notes: Lookups only work inside the mobile app, so the agent cannot check whether the number is listed. Tags other users gave the number are only visible in the app.

steps: Open the Manage Your Privacy Profile page on a device that can receive messages for the number.
Verify the number with the code sent to the phone.
Turn off the profile or hide the tags, and request deletion if offered.
If the page does not offer removal, email support@getcontact.com from the person's address and ask to delete the number and its tags.
optout.notes: Verification is a code sent to the phone, not a voice call. The privacy policy says account deletion aims to finish within 30 days. The policy also names support@getcontact.com and the in-app Privacy Management Centre for privacy requests.

verification_note: Manage page and privacy policy loaded on 2026-10-27. The manage page loads a phone verification widget, the steps after verification were not viewed.
